array.string: set -a; source /Users/daniildegtyarev/.config/roehub/roehub.env; set +a; export ROEHUB_ENV=prod; export ROEHUB_ENV_FILE=/Users/daniildegtyarev/.config/roehub/roehub.env; export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:$HOME/.local/bin; export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1; if [[ -n "${ROEHUB_NOTIFICATIONS_TELEGRAM_PROXY_URL:-}" ]]; then export HTTPS_PROXY="${ROEHUB_NOTIFICATIONS_TELEGRAM_PROXY_URL}"; export HTTP_PROXY="${ROEHUB_NOTIFICATIONS_TELEGRAM_PROXY_URL}"; export https_proxy="${ROEHUB_NOTIFICATIONS_TELEGRAM_PROXY_URL}"; export http_proxy="${ROEHUB_NOTIFICATIONS_TELEGRAM_PROXY_URL}"; export NO_PROXY="127.0.0.1,localhost"; export no_proxy="${NO_PROXY}"; fi; export STRATEGY_PG_DSN="${STRATEGY_PG_DSN:-${POSTGRES_DSN:-host=127.0.0.1 port=5432 dbname=${POSTGRES_DB:-roehub} user=${POSTGRES_USER:-roe} password=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}}}"; export NOTIFICATIONS_PG_DSN="${NOTIFICATIONS_PG_DSN:-${STRATEGY_PG_DSN}}"; cd /opt/roehub/app; exec /opt/roehub/app/.venv/bin/python -m apps.worker.notification_dispatcher.main.main --config /opt/roehub/app/configs/prod/notifications.yaml
